## 4. Studio Etiquette & Booking Policy
- Deposit: $20 non-refundable deposit required upon booking.
- Guest Policy: Solo appointments only. No extra guests or children permitted due to private suite space.
- Late Policy: 5-minute grace period. $5 late fee applies after 5 minutes.
- Cancellation: At least 24 hours notice required to reschedule or cancel.
- Pre-Appointment: Arrive bare-nailed, know your style/bring inspo, wash hands before appointment, arrive on time.
